cards.card_text: Now he too must drink and expose his uncircumcision.
cards.verse_text: You too must drink and expose your uncircumcision!
cards.snippet: You too must drink and expose your uncircumcision!

cards.card_text: Paul says, "Circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing." Then he says keeping God's ___ is what counts.
cards.verse_text: Circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing.
cards.snippet: Circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing.

cards.card_text: In Christ Jesus, Paul says neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value.
cards.verse_text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value.
cards.snippet: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value.

cards.card_text: Neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything, Paul says.
cards.verse_text: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything.
cards.snippet: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything.

cards.card_text: Then Paul looks back at where they started: dead in their trespasses and in the uncircumcision of their sinful nature.
cards.verse_text: When you were dead in your trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your sinful nature, God made you alive with Christ.
cards.snippet: When you were dead in your trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your sinful nature, God made you alive with Christ.
